notes: NEW: GUIDED CLEAN button - the beginner mode. It sorts the scan into three piles in plain words (junk to remove / your stuff, kept / not sure, left alone), removes only the junk, then re-scans and calls the phone CLEAN only at zero. SAFETY: famous apps (Facebook etc.) and Google/Samsung system pieces can never land in the junk pile, and their rows now start UNCHECKED - a stray REMOVE ALL can't take them.
